Spike region learning

OLD campaign, final DEV repeat 5. Each dot is one simulation, shown where it sat as a test run in its fold. Fill shows the predicted side of the level set {velocity spike log-ratio ≥ log 2} after b paid simulations; a ring marks a wrong prediction. Crosses are the runs the selected fold paid, in query order.

predicted spiky (inside the region)
predicted not spiky
prediction wrong for this run
+ paid by the selected fold

Learning (balanced accuracy on test runs) and collection (where the paid runs fall) are different things: a selector can pay many runs near the boundary and still learn it no faster. Axes: log h = log P − 0.5 log VX − 1.5 log LS (normalized enthalpy without constants), log VX in m/s.

Checked: every balanced accuracy on this page equals the frozen evaluator's value in report/region_endpoints.csv (12 arms × budgets 8/16/24/32/40, largest difference 1e-16). Evidence label: DEV.
